$comment: Beats are the sections of the paper. The research skill works this list top to bottom. `quota` is the target number of stories per edition; `minQuota` is the floor below which the edition is still publishable.

beats.label: Models
beats.blurb: Frontier releases, benchmarks, capability jumps and deprecations.

beats.label: Research
beats.blurb: Papers, methods, interpretability and evaluation science.
queries: notable AI paper arxiv this week

beats.label: Business
beats.blurb: Funding, revenue, acquisitions, hiring and market structure.

beats.label: Policy
beats.blurb: Regulation, litigation, standards and government procurement.

beats.label: Infrastructure
beats.blurb: Chips, data centres, energy, networking and supply chain.

beats.label: Society
beats.blurb: Labour, education, security, culture and public reaction.

edition.$comment: Quotas are calibrated against what a real run actually yields once every claim has been traced to an openable primary source — deliberately not against what a good day looks like. Targets set above the achievable rate push the pipeline to fill slots it should leave empty.
